variants.advanced: Create masonry/Pinterest-style grid layout with optimal item placement. Container: CSS columns approach - columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 xl:columns-4 gap-4. Items: break-inside-avoid mb-4 for proper column flow without breaking across columns. Alternative: CSS Grid with grid-template-rows: masonry (if browser supported), or JavaScript library (Masonry.js, react-masonry-css) for precise positioning. Card structure: bg-white rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow. Image: variable height based on original aspect ratio (not forced aspect ratio), object-cover if cropping needed, lazy loading with loading="lazy" or IntersectionObserver, skeleton placeholder while loading. Content below image: p-4 with title (font-medium line-clamp-2), description (text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-3), action buttons row. Hover effect: group class on card, image scale-105 transition, shadow increase, overlay appears (absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) with action buttons (Save/Like, Share, Open icons). Gap consistency: gap-4 on container ensures equal spacing. Infinite scroll: IntersectionObserver on sentinel element near bottom, trigger loadMore function, append new items to array, render in grid. Loading state: skeleton placeholders in masonry layout matching card shapes with varying heights. Filter/sort: category pills above grid, smooth transition animation when filters change (items fade in/out or reposition). Lightbox: click image opens full-size viewer with navigation arrows, close button, image counter. Overlay buttons: Save/heart icon (toggles saved state), quick actions. Categories/tags: filterable, shown on cards as small badges. Responsive: adjust column count per breakpoint (1 mobile, 2 tablet, 3-4 desktop). Performance: virtualize rendering for very large grids (>100 items visible), only render items in/near viewport using react-window or similar. Image optimization: srcset for responsive images, WebP format. Accessibility: grid landmark, focusable cards, alt text on images.
